brokerModel: The privileged broker exposes typed fixed backends. There is no generic exec path, so a plugin cannot reach a container runtime through it.
bunnyUnitHardening: Bunny units carry systemd sandboxing directives
limits: No SELinux denial testing was performed against a deliberate invocation.
No measurement of what a confined rootless podman can reach was made.
residualExposure: A local user may invoke the binaries directly; SELinux confines what a rootless invocation can do but does not remove the code. Confinement reduces blast radius and is not a reachability answer.
